blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — The release of the ₱20,000 anniversary bonus for Cebu Provincial Government employees remains on hold as officials address an unresolved audit issue involving previous year’s bonuses. Provincial Board (PB) Member Celestino Martinez III said the proposed allocation for the incentive, which exceeds ₱100 million, was not approved by the Committee on Budget and Appropriations. Gov. Pamela Baricuatro announced the incentive in August as part of Cebu’s 457th Founding Anniversary celebration.
